what: A Light edit runs in a throwaway worktree <repo>/.claude/worktrees/light-<run-id> off HEAD; after the supervisor ends, worker-run checks the run's files against the brief's SCOPE: globs, runs its VERIFY: command under a timeout, and only then applies the run's diff to the shared checkout as a patch. `worker-run report` leads with VERIFIED:/SCOPE:/LANDED:. The trial question is whether the gate makes a cheap model's edit cheap enough to trust without the orchestrator reading the diff.
how_to_remove: Delete the TEMP-LIGHTLAND block in bin/worker-run (light_brief_header_value, light_recipe_compose, light_worktree_add, light_worktree_remove, light_start_abandon, light_verify_run, light_touched_paths, light_scope_state, light_gate), its call `light_gate` (which takes the run's terminal status) at the end of complete_run, the `light = edit` blocks in start_run (SCOPE/VERIFY parse, worktree creation, light-scope/light-verify files, light_worktree/light_shared_top/light_base in meta.json, the LIGHT_ABANDON trap), the light-verdict cat in report_run, share/light-recipes/, tests/test_light_edit.sh and this entry. allocate_run_directory stays: it is the run-id allocation start_run always had. Keeping it means the shared checkout keeps taking a cheap model's diff unreviewed.
